rule.name: PRE30-C
rule.description: Do not create a universal character name through concatenation.

rule.name: PRE31-C
rule.description: Avoid side effects in arguments to unsafe macros.

rule.name: PRE32-C
rule.description: Do not use preprocessor directives in invocations of function-like macros.

rule.name: PRE00-C
rule.description: Prefer inline or static functions to function-like macros.

rule.name: PRE01-C
rule.description: Use parentheses within macros around parameter names.

rule.name: PRE03-C
rule.description: Prefer typedefs to defines for encoding non-pointer type.

rule.name: PRE05-C
rule.description: Understand macro replacement when concatenating tokens or performing stringification.

rule.name: PRE06-C
rule.description: Enclose header files in an inclusion guard.

rule.name: PRE07-C
rule.description: Avoid using repeated question marks.

rule.name: PRE08-C
rule.description: Guarantee that header file names are unique.

rule.name: PRE09-C
rule.description: Do not replace secure functions with deprecated or obsolescent functions.

rule.name: PRE10-C
rule.description: Wrap multistatement macros in a do-while loop.

rule.name: PRE11-C
rule.description: Do not conclude macro definitions with a semicolon.

rule.name: PRE12-C
rule.description: Do not define unsafe macros.

rule.name: DCL30-C
rule.description: Declare objects with appropriate storage durations.

rule.name: DCL31-C
rule.description: Declare identifiers before using them.

rule.name: DCL36-C
rule.description: Do not declare an identifier with conflicting linkage classifications.

rule.name: DCL37-C
rule.description: Do not declare or define a reserved identifier.

rule.name: DCL38-C
rule.description: Use the correct syntax when declaring a flexible array member.

rule.name: DCL39-C
rule.description: Avoid information leakage in structure padding.

rule.name: DCL40-C
rule.description: Do not create incompatible declarations of the same function or object.

rule.name: DCL41-C
rule.description: Do not declare variables inside a switch statement before the first case label.

rule.name: DCL00-C
rule.description: Const-qualify immutable objects.

rule.name: DCL01-C
rule.description: Do not reuse variable names in subscopes.

rule.name: DCL02-C
rule.description: Use visually distinct identifiers.

rule.name: DCL06-C
rule.description: Use meaningful symbolic constants to represent literal values.

rule.name: DCL07-C
rule.description: Include the appropriate type information in function declarators.

rule.name: DLC10-C
rule.description: Maintain the contract between the writer and caller of variadic functions.

rule.name: DCL11-C
rule.description: Understand the type issues associated with variadic functions.

rule.name: DCL12-C
rule.description: Implement abstract data types using opaque types.

rule.name: DCL13-C
rule.description: Declare function parameters that are pointers to values not changed by the function as const.

rule.name: DCL15-C
rule.description: Declare file-scope objects or functions that do not need external linkage as static.

rule.name: DCL16-C
rule.description: Use 'L,' not 'l,' to indicate a long value.

rule.name: DCL18-C
rule.description: Do not begin integer constants with 0 when specifying a decimal value.

rule.name: DCL19-C
rule.description: Minimize the scope of variables and functions.

rule.name: DCL21-C
rule.description: Understand the storage of compound literals.

rule.name: DCL22-C
rule.description: Use volatile for data that cannot be cached.

rule.name: DCL23-C
rule.description: Guarantee that mutually visible identifiers are unique.

rule.name: R-3-1
rule.description: 不应在注释中使用字符序列\/*和\/\/

rule.name: R-3-2
rule.description: 在\/\/注释中不应使用行合并

rule.name: R-4-1
rule.description: 八进制和十六进制转义序列应终止

rule.name: A-4-2
rule.description: 不应使用三字符组

rule.name: R-5-1
rule.description: 外部标识符应是独特的

rule.name: R-5-2
rule.description: 在同一作用域和命名空间中声明的标识符应是独特的

rule.name: R-5-3
rule.description: 在内层作用域中声明的标识符不应隐藏在外层作用域中声明的标识符

rule.name: R-5-4
rule.description: 宏标识符应是独特的

rule.name: R-5-5
rule.description: 标识符应不同于宏名称

rule.name: R-5-6
rule.description: typedef名称应是唯一标识符

rule.name: R-5-7
rule.description: 标记名称应是唯一标识符

rule.name: R-5-8
rule.description: 定义具有外部链接的对象或函数的标识符应是唯一的

rule.name: A-5-9
rule.description: 定义具有内部链接的对象或函数的标识符应

rule.name: R-6-1
rule.description: 只能用适当的类型声明位字段

rule.name: R-6-2
rule.description: 单位命名的位字段不应是有符号整型

rule.name: R-7-1
rule.description: 不应使用八进制常量

rule.name: R-7-2
rule.description: 应在以无符号整型表示的所有整数常量后面加上"u"或"U"

rule.name: R-7-3
rule.description: 不应在后缀文字中使用小写字母"l"

rule.name: R-7-4
rule.description: 除非对象的类型是"指向常量限定字符的指针"，否则不应将字符串赋给对象

rule.name: R-8-1
rule.description: 应明确规定类型

rule.name: R-8-2
rule.description: 函数类型应为带有命名的参数的原型形式

rule.name: R-8-3
rule.description: 对象或函数的所有声明都应使用相同的名称和类型限定符

rule.name: R-8-4
rule.description: 在定义了具有外部链接的对象或函数时，兼容声明应是可见的

rule.name: R-8-5
rule.description: 外部对象或函数只能在单个文件中声明一次

rule.name: R-8-6
rule.description: 具有外部链接的标识符应仅有一个外部定义

rule.name: R-8-8
rule.description: 应在所有具有内部链接的对象和函数的声明中使用静态存储类说明符

rule.name: R-8-10
rule.description: 应使用静态存储类声明内联函数

rule.name: R-8-12
rule.description: 在枚举成员列表中，隐式指定的枚举常量的值应是唯一的

rule.name: R-8-14
rule.description: 不能使用 restrict 限定符

rule.name: A-8-7
rule.description: 若函数和对象仅在一个编译单元中引用，则不应使用外部链接来定义它们

rule.name: A-8-9
rule.description: 若对象的标识符只出现在单个函数中，则应在块作用域内定义该对象

rule.name: A-8-11
rule.description: 当声明带有外部链接的数组时，应显式指定其大小

rule.name: A-8-13
rule.description: 指针应尽可能指向以常量限定的类型

rule.name: R-9-1
rule.description: 具有自动存储期的对象的值在设置之前不应读取

rule.name: R-9-2
rule.description: 聚合或联合的初始值设定项应使用大括号括起来

rule.name: R-9-3
rule.description: 数组不应部分初始化

rule.name: R-9-4
rule.description: 对象的元素不应被初始化多次

rule.name: R-9-5
rule.description: 若指定的初始值设定项用于初始化数组对象，则应明确指定数组的大小

rule.name: R-10-1
rule.description: 操作数不应是不适当的基本类型

rule.name: R-10-2
rule.description: 本质上是字符型的表达式不应不适当地用于加减运算

rule.name: R-10-3
rule.description: 表达式的值不应赋给具有较窄基本类型或不同基本类型的对象

rule.name: R-10-4
rule.description: 进行常规算术转换的运算符的两个操作数应具有相同的基本类型

rule.name: R-10-5
rule.description: 表达式的值不应转换为不适当的基本类型

rule.name: R-10-7
rule.description: 若使用复合表达式作为在其中进行常规算术转换的运算符的一个操作数，则另一个操作数不应具有更宽的基本类型

rule.name: R-10-8
rule.description: 复合表达式的值不应转换为不同的基本类型或较宽的基本类型

rule.name: A-10-6
rule.description: 复合表达式的值不应赋给具有较宽基本类型的对象

rule.name: R-11-1
rule.description: 不应在函数的指针与任何其他类型之间进行转换

rule.name: R-11-2
rule.description: 不应在不完整类型的指针与任何其他类型之间进行转换

rule.name: R-11-3
rule.description: 不应在某种对象类型的指针与另一种对象类型的指针之间进行转换

rule.name: R-11-6
rule.description: 不应在空类型的指针与算术类型之间进行强制转换

rule.name: R-11-7
rule.description: 不应在对象的指针与非整数运算类型之间进行强制转换

rule.name: R-11-8
rule.description: 强制转换不应从指针所指向的类型去除任何const或volatile限定符

rule.name: R-11-9
rule.description: 宏NULL应是整数空指针常量的唯一允许形式

rule.name: A-11-4
rule.description: 不应在对象的指针与整数类型之间进行转换

rule.name: A-11-5
rule.description: 不应执行从空类型的指针到对象的指针的转换

rule.name: R-12-2
rule.description: 移位运算符的右操作数应比操作数的基本类型的位宽小0到1

rule.name: A-12-1
rule.description: 表达式中的运算符的优先级应显式设置

rule.name: A-12-3
rule.description: 不应使用逗号运算符

rule.name: A-12-4
rule.description: 常量表达式的计算不应导致无符号整数的回绕

rule.name: M-13-6
rule.description: sizeof运算符的操作数不应包含任何具有潜在副作用的表达式

rule.name: R-13-1
rule.description: 初始值设定项列表不应包含持久的副作用

rule.name: R-13-2
rule.description: 在所有允许的计算命令下，表达式的值及其持久副作用应相同

rule.name: R-13-5
rule.description: 逻辑&&或||运算符的右操作数不应包含持久的副作用

rule.name: A-13-3
rule.description: 除了由递增或递减运算符引起的副作用外，包含递增（++）、递减（--）运算符的完整表达式应没有其它潜在的副作用

rule.name: A-13-4
rule.description: 不应使用赋值运算符的结果

rule.name: R-14-1
rule.description: 循环计数器本质上不应是浮点型的

rule.name: R-14-2
rule.description: for循环应具有良好的结构

rule.name: R-14-3
rule.description: 控制表达式不应是不变的

rule.name: R-14-4
rule.description: if语句的控制表达式和iteration语句的控制表达式应在本质上是布尔型的

rule.name: R-15-2
rule.description: goto语句应跳转到在同一函数中稍后声明的标签

rule.name: R-15-3
rule.description: goto语句引用的任何标签都应在同一个块中声明，或者在包含goto语句的任何块中声明

rule.name: R-15-6
rule.description: iteration语句或selection语句的主体应是复合语句

rule.name: R-15-7
rule.description: 所有if … else if构造应以else语句终止

rule.name: A-15-1
rule.description: 不应使用goto语句

rule.name: A-15-4
rule.description: 用于终止任何迭代语句的break或goto语句不应超过一个

rule.name: A-15-5
rule.description: 函数应在结尾处有单个出口点

rule.name: R-16-1
rule.description: 所有switch语句应具有良好的结构

rule.name: R-16-2
rule.description: 只有在最紧密封闭的复合语句是分支语句的主体时，才能使用switch标签

rule.name: R-16-3
rule.description: 应使用无条件中断语句终止每个switch子句

rule.name: R-16-4
rule.description: 每个switch语句都应有一个default标签

rule.name: R-16-5
rule.description: default标签应作为switch语句的第一个或最后一个switch标签出现

rule.name: R-16-6
rule.description: 每个switch语句应至少有两个switch子句

rule.name: R-16-7
rule.description: switch表达式本质上不应是布尔型
